science.title: Red dwarf stars detected 'eating' Earth-like planets
science.description: Astronomers have found some of the strongest evidence yet that stars can swallow their own planets. science.title: Heron-like, fish-eating dinosaur from 70 million years ago discovered in Argentina
science.description: A new raptor-like dinosaur from some 70 million years ago that ate fish and behaved like modern herons has been unearthed from southern Patagonia. The new species, which has been named Kank australis, was identified based on the discovery of fossil remains including teeth, vertebrae, and toe bones.

science.title: Ultrafast holographic imaging reveals electron and magnetic dynamics inside next-generation materials
science.description: An extremely fast microscopy method to research the interaction of light and matter makes it possible to study optical processes on very short timescales. To this end, a German–Italian research team is combining holographic imaging with ultrafast spectroscopy in an innovative way. In this manner, even extremely short-lived electronic and magnetic phenomena—which play a major role in the development and application of novel energy materials—can be observed.

science.title: AI and drones can help improve early warning systems for Vibrio bacteria in the Baltic Sea
science.description: The presence of the marine bacterium Vibrio vulnificus, which is potentially dangerous to humans, can now be predicted up to five weeks in advance in the Baltic Sea using artificial intelligence (AI). A research team led by the Leibniz Institute for Baltic Sea Research Warnemünde (IOW) has reached this conclusion by combining high-resolution environmental, satellite, and microbiome data in an AI-based analysis.

science.title: Quantum entanglement provides a new framework for understanding chemical bonding
science.description: Chemical bonding is one of the central organizing principles of the microscopic world. It determines how atoms combine and thereby governs a wide range of physical and chemical properties of quantum systems across many length scales, ranging from small molecules and biomolecules to macroscopically large solid materials.
